# glinet_dns_secure_servers (Data Source)

Get the encrypted DNS protocols and servers of the router (`dns.get_info`). They are the values for `protocol` and `servers` of `glinet_dns` in mode `secure`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_dns_secure_servers" "all" {}

output "doh_server_names" {
  value = [for s in data.glinet_dns_secure_servers.all.servers : s.name if s.protocol == "DoH" && s.no_log]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `protocols` (List of String) Encrypted DNS protocols, for example `DoT` and `DoH` (`protos`).
- `servers` (Attributes List) Encrypted DNS servers (`serverlist`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the server validates DNSSEC (`dnssec`).
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether the server has an IPv6 address (`ipv6`).
- `name` (String) Server name (`name`). It is a value for `servers` of `glinet_dns`.
- `no_filter` (Boolean) Whether the server does not filter the answers (`nofilter`).
- `no_log` (Boolean) Whether the server does not log the queries (`nolog`).
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the server: `DoH`, `DNSCrypt` or `oDoH` (`proto`).
